shaderAddressMath.scope: Actual GLSL scalar helper body executes as JS; validates original-size mip addressing and seam continuity, not GPU texture sampling

method: Raw UV derivatives choose trilinear LOD. At each original mip, explicit wrapped-axis bilinear neighbours use clamp hardware samples so the other axis retains its exact mip edge. CW and WC are symmetric; CC/WW use native hardware samplers directly. No source UV rewrite or regenerated mip data.
originalDdsByteCheck: Local original DDS equals read-only reference byte-for-byte; BC mip payload equals original bytes after the DDS header for all three cannon smoke textures and original streak texture.
